title: Compiler stops with "Unbound static exception" on guarded or-patterns over an unboxed record
summary: A match over an unboxed record with two guarded cases in a row, each an or-pattern with the record on both sides, stops the compiler: "Unbound static exception" in native code, "exit(2) outside appropriated catch" in bytecode.

actual.text: The compiler stops with `Fatal error: Unbound static exception 2`, exit status 2.

cause: `typing/parmatch.ml`, `lub`, has no case for two unboxed record patterns, so the context of the or-pattern's handler is empty and the last case is not emitted.

fix.text: Adds the missing cases to `lub` (the same fix as for the wrong case taken in a match over an unboxed record). Builds; `test.ml` then compiles and prints the expected result; testsuite unchanged.

reference: related: PR #7450 (merged) mended the same fault in Parmatch.Compat.compat; a review comment there says lub has it too
